decision: Prefer logical owner consolidation for the complete selected RC7 removal. Physical-only is a smaller patch but incomplete; physical v4 plus a compact Public selector adds avoidable machinery when current logical bags have no constitutional retention requirement.
correctionToPriorPremise: Preserve exact historical values under their original owners. Do not freeze prospective RC7 HOW carriers as Product WHAT.

constitutionalRelations.doesNotRequire: Whole task copied into each native output.

constitutionalRelations.requires: Exact accessible selected material, supplied policy/context identity and qualifications; repeated bodies require a declared need.
constitutionalRelations.doesNotRequire: Repeated enclosing runtime carriers or inline bodies where exact owned references resolve.

constitutionalRelations.requires: Replay reconstruction, distinct observation identities, exact source/provenance and truthful unknown after-state.
Exact release-scoped published carrier from one canonical schema/definition owner.
constitutionalRelations.doesNotRequire: Forever freezing current implementation fields across prospective RCs.

constitutionalRelations.requires: Two fresh reads derive the same admitted typed terminal result and closed state; CLI returns that result.
constitutionalRelations.doesNotRequire: Current redundant native value shape, or an always-expanded historic task inside that value.
constitutionalRelations.prohibitsShortcut: Status or a caller-asserted/unverified digest is not the typed result proof.

logicalRoute: Remove native Result task and derived before copies at their existing owning output contract. Keep after, changedPaths, report/assessment, failure states and provenance; original exact input retains task/before.

Keep input-dependent validation at nativeWorkspaceWorkResultMatches and current native effect/admission owners. Resolve needed original input through exact CCall/authority/basis and projectTraversalInputAtPrefix; never infer it by equal body or root input.

Amend the existing WorksiteContextBodyMember source domain and event-prefix resolver/index for the exact already-admitted basis-input holder. Preserve current Result-holder paths and read/scope/currentness refusals. No synthetic Result, new storage layer or parallel member schema.

Keep complete after physical-fact entries. Reference unchanged bodies through the established holder; new/changed bodies are born once in this Result. Update retained-source input joins after result.task.context is removed.

Persist native instruction basis coordinates and only uniquely required retained material. Rehydrate raw input through existing execution-basis owner; its current-input derivation remains authoritative. No physical reference-patch grammar is needed for the duplicate raw input.

Return the full new typed terminal result normally across lifecycle/result/replay/CLI. Reuse existing historical terminal selection only where that selection is the actual handoff; do not add a compact mode merely to hide old fields.

compatibility: Keep exact L law and declared historical joins. Retained RC6/N2/N3 values and digests are immutable and interpreted under their original owner/contract. New RC7 output schema and identities are prospective. Any required mixed L/current join stays explicit; no automatic conversion or universal decoder promise.
proof: Conserve recoverable source input, observations, authority/effects and meaning, not obsolete canonical JSON equality between changed contracts. Prove exact new-contract result equality on both fresh reads; native same-workload bytes include binding, Result, lifecycle output, both read outputs and retained records. Exercise progressed input, retained source, basis/member refusal, changed physical identity, unknown after, and cold body resolution without the mutable worksite/cache. Existing unaffected proof is reused.
risk: More existing caller migration than the two-file physical patch; bounded moderate risk at input validation, worksite invalidation and source-member permission joins. It removes the root repeated shape and avoids maintaining two compaction layers. No line-count or measured speedup claim.
limits: This is source-grounded architecture readiness, not implementation or acceptance.

The current public barrel does not export the internal worksite body resolver; do not claim external source-blind byte retrieval from its internal fixture imports. Preserve every actually selected installed consumer access path and its proof when changing the member carrier.
